primary_worker.processing: immediate on arrival — no extra 15-minute wait

actions_fallback.floor: GitHub Actions minimum schedule interval is 5 minutes (verified: workflows API accepts */5; 15-min retired)
actions_fallback.note: Actions cron is not exact — actual spacing recorded per cycle in cycle_latency

separation.explanation: poll interval is application cadence; provider delay is a property of the upstream data

no_op_behavior: unchanged provider responses are detected by price-change idempotency and become no-op cycles
